title: Robotic Shell Catalyst Synthesis Lab
description: A robot lab assistant helps the user synthesize iridescent catalyst compounds by grinding abalone shell specimens on a chess-themed mixing station. The user must drag shell samples into the correct reaction vessels, calibrate temperature and pH via sliders, command the robot to mix reagents in sequence, and validate each step before the final catalytic crystal forms.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Build a chemistry lab scene: load 'shared_assets/robot.glb' scaled to 1.5 and positioned at (-2, 0, 0) as the robotic lab assistant. Load 'shared_assets/ABeautifulGame.glb' scaled to 0.4 and placed at (0, 0.9, 0) on a lab bench (a BoxGeometry table at y=0.45) serving as the reaction mixing station with chess pieces representing molecular catalysts. Load 'shared_assets/IridescenceAbalone.glb' scaled to 0.6 at (2, 1.0, 0) as the raw shell specimen to be processed. Use PerspectiveCamera at (0, 4, 7) looking at origin, OrbitControls enabled. Add a HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 1.5) and a DirectionalLight with shadows. Create an HTML overlay panel with: (1) a 'Collect Shell Sample' button that animates the abalone model moving to the mixing station using tween-style lerp over 60 frames, (2) a temperature slider (200-800°C) that must be set between 450-550°C, (3) a pH slider (1-14) that must be set between 6.5-7.5, (4) a 'Command Robot: Grind' button that triggers the robot arm rotating 30 degrees back and forth 3 times via sinusoidal animation, (5) a 'Command Robot: Mix' button that rotates the robot torso 15 degrees left-right repeatedly for 2 seconds, (6) a 'Synthesize' button enabled only after steps 1-5 are completed in order. Track completion of each step with boolean flags and validate parameter ranges on synthesize. On success, spawn a glowing IcosahedronGeometry crystal (MeshPhysicalMaterial with emissive blue, iridescence=1.0, metalness=0.3) above the station with a floating animation. Display step progress as 'Step X/6 complete' in an overlay div. On invalid parameters, show a red warning message. Use a dark background (0x1a1a2e) for lab ambiance.
